owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.pronouncementHash: keccak256 of the board resolution document.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_EXPIRY_PERIOD().notice: Maximum screening validity period (prevents stale entries).

TIMELOCK_PERIOD().notice: Minimum time between a proposal and its execution.

boardRole(address).notice: Board members who can propose + execute screening changes.

boardRoleProposals(address).notice: Pending board-role change proposals. Proposed by board, executed after timelock.

cancelProposal(address).notice: Cancel a pending proposal before it is executed.

emergencyRevokeBoardRole(address).notice: Owner-only emergency: revoke a board member immediately (pause power).

executeBoardRoleChange(address).notice: Any board member may execute a pending board-role change after the timelock.

executeRemoval(address).notice: Execute a pending removal after the timelock has elapsed.

executeScreening(address).notice: Execute a previously proposed screening after the timelock has elapsed.

isBoard(address).notice: Single-source board membership query (I4).         CharityModule and PurificationEscrow call this instead of maintaining         their own local boardRole mappings, so governance changes propagate to         all contracts simultaneously.

isScreened(address).notice: Returns true only when the adapter is screened AND the screening         has not expired.  ShariahVaultV2 calls this before deployCapital.

proposeBoardRoleChange(address,bool).notice: A board member proposes granting or revoking board membership.         Owner alone cannot propose — only an existing board member can.

proposeRemoval(address).notice: Propose removal of a screened adapter.

proposeScreeningTestnet(address,bytes32,.notice: Propose screening with the 2-minute testnet timelock. After 2 minutes call executeScreeningTestnet(adapter).

@title  TestnetRegistryShortTimelock
 @notice TESTNET ONLY — a minimal ShariahAdapterRegistry variant that allows
         immediate screening execution (no 30-day wait) via a 2-minute
         `TESTNET_TIMELOCK_PERIOD` constant.  Uses its own proposal and execution
         functions that read the testnet constant rather than the 30-day constant.
 !! WARNING: NEVER deploy this contract on mainnet. !!
 Identified by name — any production deploy pipeline MUST reject this contract.
 Implementation note: Solidity does not allow overriding `constant` values.
 This contract replicates only the screening proposal+execution logic with the
 short timelock and delegates to the parent for all other functions.

@title  Rehearsal
 @notice Task K PR4 — Full testnet rehearsal on Arc Testnet (chain 5042002).
 Steps:
   1. Deploy full stack from scratch with BOARD_MULTISIG set to a separate test address.
   2. Three test wallets (WALLET_A, WALLET_B, WALLET_C) deposit into Conservative V2.
   3. Board screens S3-H via 2-minute short timelock (TESTNET_SHORT_TIMELOCK=true).
   4. Agent server runs 2+ hours against deployment; captures ExecutionTriggered events.
      (This step is off-chain; the script records the wiring needed.)
   5. One cross-chain round trip via CCTP to ETH-SEPOLIA (domain 0), settled with
      settleCrossChainWithMessage including feeExecuted handling.
   6. Force stale gold oracle: confirm deposits pause only when gold position > dustThreshold.
   7. Claim profit: waterfall amounts and 3-day unlock recorded on-chain.
   8. All three wallets redeem fully.
 Environment variables required:
   DEPLOYER_PK          — private key of deployer / owner
   BOARD_MULTISIG       — address for board role (separate from deployer)
   WALLET_A             — first test depositor address
   WALLET_B             — second test depositor address
   WALLET_C             — third test depositor address
   WALLET_A_PK          — private key of WALLET_A
   WALLET_B_PK          — private key of WALLET_B
   WALLET_C_PK          — private key of WALLET_C
 Run (on a fork of Arc Testnet with vm.warp for time jumps):
   forge script contracts/script/Rehearsal.s.sol \
     --rpc-url $ARC_TESTNET_RPC \
     --broadcast \
     --private-key $DEPLOYER_PK \
     -vvvv
 On a live chain (real time): run each step as a separate script invocation after the
 required time delays have elapsed (screening: 2 minutes for testnet short timelock).
